maintenance_led.reason: Sells subscription licences to its AI-native customer experience software suites (Service, Social, Insights, Marketing), not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private global brands like Microsoft, Dow, 3M, Shell and Uber, paying for CX software subscriptions.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own single-codebase platform to enterprises; acquisitions are occasional, not its main growth path.

mission_critical.reason: Enterprise CX platform unifying service, social and marketing; replacing it means migration, retraining and integration disruption.
